initialPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: image-to-3D production reference for one small residential building, house C, in a children's tactile toy-town game.
Input image 1 is a STYLE reference: house A, premium molded painted-toy surface, softly rounded substantial architecture, warm ivory trim and opaque painted blue windows. Input image 2 is the accepted town concept for the coherent toy-town family. Create a distinct companion cottage, not a duplicate of house A. Do not include surrounding scenery from either reference.
Subject: ONE compact pistachio-green cottage, one full ground floor beneath a simple FRONT-FACING TRIANGULAR GABLE. The main roof ridge runs front to back; no cross-gable or projecting dormer. Warm muted terracotta-orange tile roof, broad softly rounded tile courses, short cream chimney toward the rear with a solid terracotta cap. Front gable filled by green wall with one small ROUND opaque blue attic window and a thick cream circular rim with a simple cross muntin. The front facade below is symmetrical: a central dark teal arched door at ground level, two small cream-framed softly arched opaque blue cross-pane windows, one each side. One matching window on the visible right side. Substantial simple cream corner stones, cream roof-edge trim, discreet cream window sills. Friendly low compact proportions: full width 5, height about 4.2, depth 4, including shallow roof eaves and chimney. The overall shape is lower than the two-storey house B and differs from house A's projecting dormer.
Materials: richly sculpted satin painted toy, soft rounded edges, subtle tactile surface, warm pistachio green, restrained earthy terracotta, warm ivory, deep teal door, deep painted blue windows. Consistent craftsmanship and chunky detail with reference house A. No tiny ornate details.
Composition: one entire building centered with ample clean margins; elevated front-right three-quarter view showing entrance, roof and right wall clearly. Neutral soft studio daylight on plain warm off-white seamless background, gentle contact shadow. All sides and roof opaque, closed chimney top. All architecture attached to a single building; door touches the ground.
Exclude: text, numbers, logos, watermarks, people, animals, trees, flower boxes, plants, garden, furniture, stairs, porch, balcony, base slab, separate plinth, pavement, roads, detached props, transparent glass, open doors, open roof, interior/cutaway, multiple views, collage. Do not make a narrow tall tower.
